Initial release of krypto-drt-scalping — a crypto adaptation of Dealing Range Theory with backtested results over 2 years.

- Supports 12 crypto pairs, trading 7 days a week, using 1-hour Dealing Range Theory setups.
- Includes detailed backtest stats: ~400 trades, ~90% win rate, and performance split by weekday/weekend.
- Trading window set for 15:00–23:00 DK time; avoids dead zone 07:00–12:00.
- Prioritized instruments and setup selection rules added for clarity.
- Separate risk management and scaling plan for a dedicated "legekonto".
- Complete daily routine, discipline checklist, and clear monthly performance expectations.
